title: A spectral gap throughout the high-temperature Sherrington–Kirkpatrick phase
main_claim: For each fixed 0<β<1, with probability tending to one over zero-field Gaussian SK disorder, Var_{μ0}(f) ≤ C_β D_0(f) for all f, where D_0 is the unscaled heat-bath Dirichlet form. So the uniform-site discrete heat-bath chain has gap ≥ 1/(C_β n). The proof runs stochastic localization (Gaussian observation) and uses three inputs: (1) stability of approximate TAP roots along observation paths, (2) a directional-covariance bound and a square-reweighted mean bound at stable fields, and (3) a terminal gap at a large fixed time T.
sibling_notes: Companions in family 227 (Cutoff, Critical-mixing, Functional-universality, Universality, Stretched-exponential) were all reported no_gap_found. The Cutoff paper relies on this paper's gap theorem as its SKGap input. This paper is self-contained apart from the cited classical tools. Its terminal gap adapts Wang 2026 Lemma 3.4 but reproves the variant used here in full.
